shots.why: knowledge/DEMO-SCRIPT.md section 1 is the demo's shape: six shots, one caption each, 180.00 s. This table carries that shape inside the route data, so the demo the build walks and the demo the cut shows cannot drift apart. The route below is what the game plays; a shot names the route steps its picture is taken from, and S4 and S5 share `quay` and `morgan` because one scene holds two shots.

title_card.why: Judge panel fix 3 of 2026-11-16 (card t_b231fe46). The 2026-11-14 panel (card t_5876de50) asked for a card in the first seconds and the 2026-11-15 panel (card t_379273cc) raised the hold to five; the 2026-11-16 panel then judged a still at 15.0 s from what is now the only S1 footage on disk, the 2026-10-26 attract, and saw blue bands with one caption and no readable word. So the card now holds S1's whole scripted 16.00 s (0:00.00 to 0:16.00) and is drawn opaque, which replaces that picture instead of dimming it: the opening states the game's name, what it is, the Meta talk judge's model id read from tools/meta_client.py at draw time, the controls from pp_input's own bindings, the boot menu with CONTINUE marked off because a cold boot has nothing saved, the NES limits, and the S1 caption verbatim. The words and the menu are tools/video_builder.py's title_card_lines() and TITLE_MENU_ROWS; nothing here retypes an id. S1 keeps its 16.00 s, so the cut still sums to 180.00 s.

rows.caption: Cold boot to menu takes 14 seconds. CONTINUE is dim, because nothing is saved yet.
The crawl runs 1,238 steps. Hold confirm to read it faster; no page is skipped.
Town Quay in the hurricane. The storm runs on its own seeded clock, 8 step flashes over a real Southampton block.
Morgan asks three things and two answers are enough. No reply can lose the talk, and the wind drops when he does.
Three replies, each a row of data/meta_bake.json, and a WILL bar that only goes up.
Percy is talked down, the storm ends, the credits name the Meta models; play the build offline from the repo.
